ideas.name: C1: Restrict to active interactions
ideas.description: Compute the xgboost model's actual co-occurring variable pairs along tree paths (from the trees' split structure). Pass only those pairs, ranked by gain or frequency and truncated to the top few, as interaction_list. This drops empty interaction components, which cuts runtime and removes noisy components. Keep the number of pairs fixed across seeds.

ideas.name: C2: Residual refit on components
ideas.description: After fitting TreeHFD on the training data, compute the residuals between the model predictions and the component sum. Fit a ridge regression of the model predictions on the stacked component columns (main effects and interactions) to get per-component scalar weights and an intercept. Apply these weights on test data. Each component still depends only on its own variables.

ideas.name: C3: Residual spline main effects
ideas.description: Take the residual (model prediction minus current component sum) on training data. For each variable, fit a low-order spline or binned smoother on that variable alone. Do the same for each selected variable pair, using a 2D binned smoother or tensor spline. Add these corrections to the matching components. Evaluate on held-out data.
